items.title: A rule satisfying the bivariant conditions only for trivially normal bundles is already a bivariant class
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter chow.tex (Chow Homology and Chern Classes)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file chow.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that a rule assigning pullback maps on Chow groups and satisfying the bivariant conditions (1) and (2) together with condition (3) only for divisors with trivial conormal bundle is already a full bivariant class (statement lines 6518-6535, tag 0F9A). The proof is a genuine reduction: it replaces the given triple by a smooth morphism of relative dimension one built from the normal cone lemma, on which the conormal bundle is trivial by construction, uses the characterising uniqueness of that construction for two different classes, and then transfers the hypothesis along the base change to conclude the missing condition (3). The construction and the two uniqueness comparisons are the substance, so the claim is H2.
